names.note: Read out of doxologia.ro's line for 26 noiembrie, «Sfântul Cuvios Stelian Paflagonul», with the rank words left off.

Read out of saint.gr's line for 26 Νοεμβρίου, «Όσιος Στυλιανός ο Παφλαγόνας», with the rank word left off; the epithet «ο Παφλαγόνας» is the folder's own distinguishing word already and is not repeated in the stored form.

The heading of days.pravoslavie.ru's name page 13102, «Стилиан Пафлагонянин, прп.», with the trailing grade left off. The day line declines the name and makes the by-name an adjective of its own, «Стилиана Пафлагонского».

Read out of the Охридски пролог’s heading for 26. новембар ст. ст., „Преп. Стилијан.“ — «Преп.» is Преподобни, the `venerable` grade this folder already keeps, so it comes off and the heading prints nothing else; Paphlagonia is in the body, so there was no «Стилијан Пафлагонац» on the page to copy. Measured before it was written: no other folder in the corpus holds this string and it joins no fold. It is not folded towards the Russian «Стилиан Пафлагонянин» or the Romanian «Stelian Paflagonul» this folder already carries.

feast.note: His name page gives «День памяти: 26 ноября» and no other day, so the calendar keeps him on this one day alone.

source.text: Православный церковный календарь, Сретенский монастырь (days.pravoslavie.ru), 26 ноября ст. ст. — «Прп. Стилиана Пафлагонского (V-VI).»
Calendarul zilei, Doxologia (doxologia.ro), 26 noiembrie — «Sfântul Cuvios Stelian Paflagonul»
saint.gr, το εορτολόγιο της 26ης Νοεμβρίου — «Όσιος Στυλιανός ο Παφλαγόνας»

attestations.note: The life page `https://www.saint.gr/3096/saint.aspx` heads «Τύπος εορτής: Σταθερή. Εορτάζει στις 26 Νοεμβρίου εκάστου έτους», the same day the folder's Romanian row already carries, and the man is the folder's own. **The page hedges the Paphlagonia of his name** — «που μάλλον γεννήθηκε στην Παφλαγονία, χωρίς αυτό να είναι σίγουρο, διότι εκεί φυλασσόταν και ιερό λείψανο του», probably born there, without that being certain, because a relic of his was kept there — and the hedge stands in the life. It gives no year at all, so no `dates` object is proposed. **The page was read in its opening and closing stretches only**, some four hundred and seventy characters of the middle unread, which is where its account of the children is; the reader's report names the limit. The hymn taken is the page's Ἀπολυτίκιον (Κατέβασμα), which names him and no other saint and carries both an ἦχος and a model; its «Έτερον Ἀπολυτίκιον», which names him too and makes him the protector of infants, is printed with neither an ἦχος nor a model and is not drafted. The page adds his head at the metropolis of Thessaliotis and portions at Damasta in Phthiotis, Leimonos on Lesbos, Dadi in Phthiotis and Kato Xenia at Almyros in Magnesia. No asterisk and not the sentence «Δεν είναι διασταυρωμένη η ύπαρξη του Αγίου».

source.text: Православни подсетник (pravoslavno.rs), Охридски пролог за 09.12.2025 (26. новембар ст. ст.) — „Преп. Стилијан.“

attestations.note: The day’s third entry, SEVEN SENTENCES. `dates` UNTOUCHED, AND THE ENTRY GIVES A TENSION THAT CANNOT BE WRITTEN AS A DATE: it makes him «земљак и савременик св. Алимпија», the countryman and contemporary of the first entry’s Alypius, whose own years this corpus holds as a birth of 522 and a death of 608 or 640, while this folder holds «5th–6th century» off the Russian calendar’s Roman figures. A contemporary of a man of the sixth and seventh centuries is not plainly a man of the fifth and sixth. THE BOOK GIVES HIM NO YEAR, NO REIGN AND NO CENTURY OF HIS OWN, so there is nothing here to write into `dates` and nothing was written; the contemporaneity is recorded in the life and in this note and is a line for the author. ONE `related` row added, both halves: the countryman and contemporary the entry names. WHAT THE ENTRY ADDS: that he was a Paphlagonian; the exceeding love of the Lord Jesus that drove him to great ascetic labours; the renouncing of everything so that his love should be undivided; THE ANGELS WHO CAME BEFORE HIS DEATH TO TAKE HIS SOUL AND HIS FACE SHINING LIKE THE SUN; and that he helps sick children above all, and parents who have none.

hymns.text: Στήλη ἔμψυχος τῆς ἐγκρατείας, στῦλος ἄσειστος τῆς Ἐκκλησίας Στυλιανὲ ἀνεδείχθης μακάριε· ἀνατεθεὶς γὰρ Θεῷ ἐκ νεότητος κατοικητήριον ὤφθης τοῦ Πνεύματος. Πάτερ ὅσιε Χριστὸν τὸν Θεὸν ἱκέτευε δωρίσασθαι ἡμῖν τὸ μέγα ἔλεος.

source.text: saint.gr, Ἀπολυτίκιον (Κατέβασμα), Ἦχος γ’, Θείας πίστεως — the first hymn on the page of «Όσιος Στυλιανός ο Παφλαγόνας». It names him and no other saint, and plays on his name — στήλη and στῦλος, the pillar. The reading «δωρίσασθαι» is the page's own.

english.text: A living column of self-restraint, an unshaken pillar of the Church, you were shown to be, blessed Stylianos; for being dedicated to God from your youth you appeared a dwelling-place of the Spirit. Venerable father, entreat Christ our God to grant us his great mercy.

death.note: days.pravoslavie.ru closes its line for him with a century range in Roman figures where it would otherwise print a year — «Прп. Стилиана Пафлагонского (V-VI).» — and that is the whole of what it says about when he lived. Neither doxologia.ro nor saint.gr gives him a year or a century at all, so this interval is the only dating any calendar read supplies and it is recorded at the full width of the parenthesis; no year within it is chosen.
